enquiries_attributed_to_page.evidence: 0 Consumers and 0 Enquiries records have a Source_Url containing 'portugal'. Across all 15,432 Consumers records, only 3 have a Source_Url containing '/destinations/', so destination pages barely register as an enquiry source today.

metrics.summary: Baseline is effectively zero on every commercial measure: 0 clicks, no third-party visibility, 0 attributed enquiries. Any measurable improvement starts from nothing, so the 90-day targets should be framed as first impressions on page 1 to 2 and first attributed enquiries, not percentage uplift.

crm_signal.method: COQL, read only, aggregates only. Consumers: LIKE on Destination_Country, Wedding_Location, Destination_Wedding_Place (text) and Venue_of_Interest, Contact_Us_Message (textarea, which COQL does accept on Consumers) for Portugal, Portugu, Lisbon, Algarve, Sintra, Douro, Porto (Portofino excluded), Comporta, Madeira. Origin checked separately on Country and Country_List. No names, emails, phones, messages or record ids were copied.

portugal_destination_records.match_source: 3 on Wedding_Location or Destination_Country only, 1 on both a location field and a textarea, 2 on textareas only (Venue_of_Interest or Contact_Us_Message)
portugal_destination_records.genuine_planning_enquiries_estimate: about 2 to 3. Two records came from giveaway entry forms (one is a US couple of 2 plus a witness that was also tagged 'Local', which contradicts its Portugal destination), and one came from the get-featured form, which may be a past wedding rather than a future booking.

budget_bands.caveat: All three non-blank budgets are exactly 50,000, the known default on recent records (personas README issue 1). No concatenated picklist ranges appeared in this set. There is no usable budget signal for Portugal.

origin_countries.note: No Australian-origin Portugal enquiries at all, against 46% Australian origin across the persona sample. This fits F011: US and UK hold about 97% of Portugal search demand.

portugal_origin_records_not_marrying_in_.detail: 18 Consumers have Country or Country_List = Portugal; 2 of those are in the destination set above. Of the other 16, 13 are status New from 2024 to May 2025 with no destination recorded, 1 is getting married in Mallorca (budget 900,000, treat as unverified), 1 in Angola and 1 is blank. Not demand for this page.

benchmarks_for_context.caveat: Broad LIKE counts on location fields plus Contact_Us_Message, not de-duplicated for spam. Use only as an order of magnitude: Portugal enquiry demand is roughly a fourteenth of Italy and a quarter of Greece.

persona_resemblance.closest: intl-couple-europe-full-service (by origin: US, Canada and Western Europe residents, no Australians)
persona_resemblance.secondary: intimate-destination-elopement (the one record with a guest count is 2 plus a witness)
persona_resemblance.least_supported_by_crm: au-couple-marrying-abroad, the panel's primary persona for destination hubs, has 0 Portugal records
persona_resemblance.confidence: low: 6 records with almost no budget or guest data. Treat this as a direction for the persona weighting, not evidence.

enquiries_module_b2c.detail: Lead_Status: New 12, Duplicate Consumer 3, Start 1. 14 of the 16 were created within minutes of each other on 14 and 15 Jan 2026 (Wedded Wonderland and Wedded Week forms), which looks like a bulk import or a spam burst. The other 2 (Jul and Aug 2026) mirror Consumers records already counted. Country_List appears to be the enquirer's country, not the wedding destination. None have a Source_Url on a Portugal page, and none have a budget.
enquiries_module_b2c.limitation: COQL rejects LIKE on the Enquiries textareas (Message, Contact_Us_Message: 'unsupported column in criteria'), so Enquiries could not be searched for Portugal as a destination.

crm_signal.headline: CRM demand for Portugal is thin (6 Consumers records, about 2 to 3 genuine, 0 booked), does not come from this page, and is international rather than Australian. The page's commercial job is to start demand from the US and UK, not to capture existing Australian demand.

data_gaps: GA4 is not available in this environment: no sessions, engagement, scroll or conversion data for the page.

GSC data is a user summary only (F017): no impression totals, per-query impressions, CTR by query or trend. A GSC export (page filter, 16 months, by query and country) is needed for a proper before and after.

Enquiries cannot be attributed to this page today: Source_Url is blank on 3 of the 6 Portugal Consumers records, and the live page has no form (F015), so the page cannot generate an attributable enquiry until the Stage 5 hidden fields (page slug, Source_Url, UTM fields, Brand_Name) are live.
No dataLayer events are confirmed on the live page. Raw HTML could not be fetched (current.md is a parsed capture), so existing GA4 or GTM tags are unverified.
Budget: all non-blank Portugal budgets are the 50,000 default; there is no real budget signal (personas README issue 1).
Guest_Count is blank on all Portugal records; only one free-text Number_of_Guests value exists.
There are no won or booked Portugal records, so there is no conversion baseline and no booked-wedding profile for Portugal.
Reason_for_Not_a_Fit and Reason_for_Not_Proceeding were not populated on the Lost and Not Interested Portugal records (in line with personas README issue 2), so the reasons for loss are unknown.
Local_or_Destination_Wedding is blank or contradictory (one Portugal destination record is tagged Local).
Enquiries module textareas cannot be filtered in COQL, so Portugal destination intent in Enquiries is unmeasured. Country_List there seems to mean origin, not destination.
Third-party tools hold no data for the page URL (DataForSEO: 0 ranked keywords, no traffic estimate). Semrush was not queried, to keep spend modest.
Australian demand is small (AU 70 a month for the primary keyword, F008) and has 0 CRM records, so Australian-market KPIs will have very low counts.

assumptions: F017 GSC summary is treated as the primary performance baseline; no impression totals were supplied, so impressions are recorded as positions only.

A record counts as Portugal demand if a destination or location field, Venue_of_Interest or Contact_Us_Message names Portugal or a Portuguese place. Records where only the enquirer's country is Portugal are counted separately as origin, not demand.
Porto was searched with Portofino excluded; it returned no extra records.
The 'genuine planning enquiry' estimate (about 2 to 3) is a judgement from Source_Url form type and status, not a verified classification.
Enquiries Country_List is read as the enquirer's country, based on its overlap with Consumers origin records and on the Jan 2026 burst having no destination data.
Italy and Greece counts are broad, unrefined matches used only for scale.

open_questions.question: Can you supply a GSC export for /destinations/europe/portugal (16 months, by query and country, with impressions and CTR) and GA4 access or an export (sessions, engagement, conversions for the page)? Without them the 90-day review can only compare clicks, positions and CRM counts.
Was the cluster of 14 Portugal-origin B2C Enquiries created on 14 and 15 Jan 2026 a bulk import or spam? It should be excluded from any persona refresh if so.

The CRM shows 0 Australian Portugal enquiries and leans to US, Canada and European origin. Should the persona weighting for this page lift intl-couple-europe-full-service alongside au-couple-marrying-abroad (the default primary for destination hubs)?
For the Lost and Not Interested Portugal records, can Reason_for_Not_a_Fit or Reason_for_Not_Proceeding be backfilled? It is the only loss signal available for this destination.
